about_the_game:
Take on the challenge and dive into amazing world of platformer game Butterfly Learn To Fly!

Every jump brings you closer to a magical transformation—from a simple caterpillar into a graceful butterfly.

 But be careful on your way: one wrong move - and you will fall, and part of the path will have to pass again. The stakes are high - be precise!

- There is only one way - up, and you have only one enemy - your awkwardness

- Use rotating objects and platforms going up and down to get to the top.

- The deeper you dive, the more water is pushed out. Use it, but don't drown!

- Use your weight wherever possible and run.

- You will have helpers along the way and you will quickly realize who they are. They will never let you down and will always lift you up.
